Meal plans on a budget · 2026 Affordable meal plans in Dubai

By the Messify team · Updated October 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

An affordable meal plan is one with a fair price per meal that you actually use. Messify meal plans in Dubai cost AED 25.63 to 30.71 a meal: from AED 215 a week or AED 715 a month. The 3-meal monthly plan has the lowest price per meal (AED 25.63), and the 1-meal weekly plan has the lowest upfront cost.

What makes a meal plan affordable

An affordable meal plan is not just the one with the lowest headline price. It is the one with a fair price per meal, a total you can fit into your monthly budget, and meals you actually eat. A plan you only use half of costs twice as much per meal as it says on the page.

So check three things: the price per meal (plan price ÷ number of meals), what that price includes, and how much time you get to use your meals.

Six ways to keep your meal plan affordable

  1. Try a week, then go monthly. Monthly plans cost less per meal on every plan size, so switch once you know you like the food.
  2. Only buy the meals you'll eat. If you eat breakfast at home, a 2-meal plan beats a 3-meal plan you don't finish.
  3. Use every meal. With Messify, skip a busy day in the app and use that meal later in your plan, instead of letting it go to waste.
  4. Compare per meal, including fees. Delivery, service fees and VAT change the real price of ordering in and of some plans.
  5. Skip extras you don't need. Diet and fitness plans with snacks, juices and calorie tracking cost more per meal. If you just want everyday meals sorted, an everyday meal plan costs less.
  6. Check delivery to your building first. Messify delivers in Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City and Dubai Festival City.

Affordable, not the cheapest

We'd rather be straight with you. Cooking for yourself is cheaper on ingredients, if you have the time and a kitchen. And some companies publish lower starting prices on certain plans: when we last checked, Right Bite listed its Essentials plan from AED 22 a meal. Our comparison of Dubai meal plans shows published prices side by side.

Where Messify fits is everyday meals at a predictable price: breakfast, lunch and dinner delivered together every morning, a new menu every day, 100% halal, with a vegetarian option every day, for every meal.

Who an affordable meal plan suits

  • Students in shared residences with small kitchens. See student meal plans in Dubai.
  • Young professionals who order in most days and want one predictable food bill.
  • Office workers who want lunch sorted before the workday starts.

Questions people ask

What is the most affordable meal plan in Dubai?

Compare the price per meal, not the plan price. Messify's lowest price per meal is the 3-meal monthly plan at AED 25.63. When we last checked, Right Bite listed its Essentials plan from AED 22 a meal. Check what each price includes and where each company delivers.

Is a meal plan cheaper than ordering food in Dubai?

If you order in most days, a meal plan usually costs less per meal once delivery and service fees are counted. Use the calculator on this page with what you really spend.

How much is a monthly meal plan in Dubai?

Messify monthly plans cost AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day, which is AED 25.63 to 27.50 a meal.

What is the cheapest way to try a meal plan?

Start with a weekly plan. Messify's 1-meal weekly plan costs AED 215 for 7 meals.

Do I lose meals if I skip a day?

With Messify, no. Skip a day in the app and use that meal later in your plan. Monthly plans give you 30 days to use 26 days of meals, and weekly plans give you 9 days to use 7.
